export interface UserLoggedInData {
  email: string;
  federatedClaims?: {
    accessToken: Record<string, unknown>;
    idToken: Record<string, unknown>;
  } | null;
  flowcatalystClaims: {
    applications: string[];
    clients: string[];
    email: string;
    roles: string[];
    type: string;
  };
  identityProviderCode?: string | null;
  loginMethod: string;
  userId: string;
}
